mapper.select: SELECT c.camp_id AS campId, c.name AS name, p.poi_id AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName FROM pms_camp c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT camp_id, poi_id, poi_name FROM ( SELECT poi.camp_id, poi.poi_id, poi.poi_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY poi.camp_id ORDER BY poi.sort_no ASC, poi.poi_id ASC) AS row_num FROM pms_poi poi WHERE poi.is_deleted = 0 AND poi.status = 1 ) ranked_poi WHERE ranked_poi.row_num = 1 ) p ON p.camp_id = c.camp_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.camp_id ASC

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.mobile AS mobile, u.email AS email, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.avatar_url AS avatarUrl, u.wechat AS wechat, u.password_hash AS passwordHash, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName, m.camp_id AS campId, m.role_id AS roleId, r.role_code AS roleCode, r.role_name AS roleName, c.name AS campName, p.poi_id AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName FROM pms_user u JOIN pms_member m ON m.user_id = u.user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 JOIN pms_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN pms_camp c ON c.camp_id = m.camp_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT camp_id, poi_id, poi_name FROM ( SELECT poi.camp_id, poi.poi_id, poi.poi_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY poi.camp_id ORDER BY poi.sort_no ASC, poi.poi_id ASC) AS row_num FROM pms_poi poi WHERE poi.is_deleted = 0 AND poi.status = 1 ) ranked_poi WHERE ranked_poi.row_num = 1 ) p ON p.camp_id = m.camp_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.username = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.mobile = #{mobile}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pms_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.email = #{email}

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.remark, ''), r.role_name) AS description FROM pms_role r WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT c.camp_id AS campId, c.name AS name, p.poi_id AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName FROM pms_camp c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT camp_id, poi_id, poi_name FROM ( SELECT poi.camp_id, poi.poi_id, poi.poi_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY poi.camp_id ORDER BY poi.sort_no ASC, poi.poi_id ASC) AS row_num FROM pms_poi poi WHERE poi.is_deleted = 0 AND poi.status = 1 ) ranked_poi WHERE ranked_poi.row_num = 1 ) p ON p.camp_id = c.camp_id WHERE c.camp_id = #{campId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.remark, ''), r.role_name) AS description, 0 AS memberCount, FALSE AS canDelete, DATE_FORMAT(r.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM pms_role r WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.status = 1 AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.is_system DESC, r.role_id ASC

SELECT ad.authority_code FROM pms_role_authority pra JOIN authority_dict ad ON ad.authority_id = pra.authority_id WHERE pra.role_id = #{roleId} AND ad.status = 1 ORDER BY ad.seq_no ASC, ad.authority_id ASC

SELECT c.camp_id AS campId, c.name AS campName,
COALESCE(p.poi_name, c.name) AS name,
c.name AS name,
COALESCE(p.city_name, c.city_name) AS cityName, COALESCE(p.full_address, p.address, c.address) AS address, COALESCE(p.contact_number, c.contact_number) AS contactNumber, p.poi_id AS poiId, p.poi_name AS poiName, p.poi_type AS poiType, p.poi_type AS typeName, p.poi_type AS campTypeName, COALESCE(p.contact_number, c.contact_number) AS phone, p.city_path AS cityPath, p.street_address AS streetAddress, p.community_name AS communityName, p.unit_no AS unitNo, COALESCE(p.full_address, p.address, c.address) AS fullAddress, CAST(COALESCE(p.tags_json, tags_cfg.config_value) AS CHAR) AS tagsJson, p.plain_intro AS plainIntro, p.rich_intro AS richIntro, p.cover_image_data_url AS coverImageDataUrl, p.photo_count AS photoCount FROM pms_camp c LEFT JOIN pms_poi p ON p.camp_id = c.camp_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1
AND p.poi_id = #{poiId}
LEFT JOIN system_config tags_cfg ON tags_cfg.camp_id = c.camp_id AND tags_cfg.config_scope = 'camp' AND tags_cfg.config_key = 'hudson.campInfo.tags' WHERE c.camp_id = #{campId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort_no ASC, p.poi_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ca.channel_id AS channelId, ca.channel_name AS channelName, ca.account_id AS accountId, ca.account_name AS accountName, pr.poi_id AS poiId, pr.sync_status AS syncStatus, ca.status AS status FROM channel_account ca LEFT JOIN channel_poi_rel pr ON pr.account_id = ca.account_id AND pr.camp_id = ca.camp_id WHERE ca.camp_id = #{campId} ORDER BY ca.account_id ASC, pr.poi_id ASC
